timelinePolicy.trajectory: Connect independently documented historical event locations, not travel routes. Equal order denotes shared campaign phase with unknown internal order; do not connect equal-order stops as sequential. Regional anchors are approximate. Unresolved stops remain visible in textual itinerary; never invent coordinates. No inference of individual presence at every subordinate action.
